## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
(None — test-update task that prepares the test bed for the differ rewrite in task-4 and task-5; DD ownership is via those tasks.)

The existing tests tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py and tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py assert the old snapshot-diff API. Rewrite to assert the new contract: differ accepts (local_state, jira_state) plain-dict inputs; returns list[Mutation] from dso_reconciler.mutation; assertions inspect Mutation fields (direction, action, target, payload, provenance). Update fixtures to new input shape. Tests will FAIL after this lands (because differ.py still emits old shape) — that's the RED state task-4/task-5 turn GREEN.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py
- [ ] Updated test_differ.py imports Mutation from dso_reconciler.mutation
  Verify: grep -q 'from dso_reconciler.mutation import' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py
- [ ] Updated test_differ_conflict_resolution.py asserts on Mutation.action enum values
  Verify: grep -q 'MutationAction' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py
- [ ] Updated tests collect without ImportError (RED state for differ.py is acceptable)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest --collect-only tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py

## File Impact
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ.py — Edit
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py — Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
data.title: Update existing differ tests to assert the new direction-tagged Mutation API
